quest.title: Nahuatzin's Leap
quest.description: Find a way to enter the volcano...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x300, Primogem x40, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x3

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Chosen of Dragons, O Chosen of Dragons...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ascend to the circlet's highest pinnacle — then hurl yourself into the Sacred Mountain's fire!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Go forth and reveal it — break the golden seal, unveil the radiance of remnant flames unnumbered!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rrroar...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's wrong? Did you see a bunch of strange words again?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, you mean it's because we're getting closer to the volcano?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...It's almost as if the person who's been talking to you all this time is in that mountain.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyway, since those things are showing up as we're getting closer to the volcano, that's gotta mean we're on the right track.

choices.text: It feels like... we're getting closer...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Was that a Q—Qucusaur?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Did it just grab that statue and jump... straight into the crater!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's gotta be the volcano's mouth, right? What a view...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... When we asked for directions earlier, weren't we told that there's a ton of gaseous phlogiston in the volcano's mouth?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh wait, that's right! We can <color=#00E1FFFF>find a way to pass through gaseous phlogiston</color>, just like the Qucusaurus from back there!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But, uh... *gulp* Kinda high up, aren't we?

choices.text: Don't you worry, Paimon, I'll carry you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Err, you wanna go in too? Well... Ugh, alright. I—If that's the case, Paimon's not that scared anymore.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And it's not just that we're high up — don't forget about the gaseous phlogiston!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: A—Anyway, let's make sure we're all set before we go!

choices.text: As long as you grab me just as we land...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ugh, Paimon couldn't do that! Never mind the strength problem — think about the timing!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And you too! Stop "rawring" along with this craziness! *sigh* ...Y'know what, now you two've gone and killed all the tension!

talks.objective: Go to the top of the Skyfire Circlet

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh! Could this statue be the one that Kimosi said a Qucusaurus stole?
